note: The manager's Foray tape scenarios (NE-30j), recorded from the real PlayerQueueManager over the shared fakes: in-points and out-points, the out-point as the item's end, back-to-back slices of one episode, speed across seams, the ADR-0007 ladder at load, the report of what was dropped, and the seam beat with every transport action during it (fast and slow loads). Port card NE-30s.
